rationale: Modular mixins allow for composable configuration pipelines.
Inheritance segregation is a superior OOP pattern for complex settings.
Un-hides the configuration structure, making it easier to reason about the procedural flow.
Declarative blocks for functional units (GitHub, AI) improve readability.
Unpack provides type safety without the friction of a separate DTO class for every call.
Explicitly categorized settings improve auditability and quality control.
Solves the 'obfuscation' concern while leveraging modern Python standards.
